CATEGORY: 别的 vs. 另外 (Vocabulary (word choice))
definition: 别的 means a different type or all others except the one mentioned. 另外 means an additional quantity or another/the other.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (3 distinct):
5 | “别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
3 | “别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
1 | there is no “别个人”.

output.rule: 别的 is for a different type or for all others except the one already mentioned. 另外 is for an additional quantity, or for another/the other; say 另外一个人, not 别个人.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: this means an additional/another <noun>, so use 另外, not 别的.

examples.explanation: 一个别的人 → 另外一个人: this means another person, so use 另外 for another/the other.
别的白花 → 另外一种白花: this means an additional kind of white flower, so use 另外 for addition.
别的人 → 另外一个人: this means another person, so use 另外一个人.
别个人 → 另外一个人: there is no 别个人; use 另外一个人 for another person.

output.not_an_error: Do not flag 别的 when it means a different type or all others except the one already mentioned.
